newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen steady in consolidative mood.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen steady in consolidative mood.

text.p: The outlook on Singapore stocks was steady on Tuesday with the market entering a consolidative phase after recent falls.
Dealers said, however, that with the Hong Kong handover featuring prominently this week and a lack of incentives for the region, turnover would probably stay dismal.
"People may be looking forward to the budget but there are no fresh leads out there," a foreign brokerage dealer said.
Singapore is due to announce its budget on July 11.
On Monday, the Straits Times Industrials Index (STII) closed 13.58 points higher at 1,987.95 on volume of 126 million lots.
Retail interest in small issues and China-linked counters is expected to continue buoyant.
